# Jay VA

> Jay Boy Olan-Olan (Jay VA) is a Social Media Manager, Content Strategist, and Website Designer based in the Philippines, helping businesses build a premium online presence through strategic content, social media management, graphic design, video editing, and high-converting websites.

Jay VA offers social media management, content strategy, graphic design, video editing, photo editing, and website/landing page design. Client work spans niches including boutique hotels, real estate, skincare, denim/fashion brands, and travel.

- [Portfolio](https://jayva.vercel.app/#portfolio): Featured graphic design, video editing, photo editing, and website projects, including the live Villa Merced Hotel website
- [Services](https://jayva.vercel.app/#services): Social media management, content strategy, graphic design, video & photo editing, website & landing page design
